items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: Bozo Nickerson come in and do it at the same time. They both come from the show together.

ctx.x: And when did Bozo Nickerson come in?

Bozo Nickerson come in and do it at the same time. They both come from the show together. The show broke up here in Memphis. We went stranded. Bozo Nickerson played piano and sang too. He was a black-faced comedian on stage. Ma'am! He put out Sadie Green.
What did you do at the end of Sadie Green? You told me a while about it. Get on.
